description:
A collection of Active Directory Tools to streamline Active Directory

Active Directory Pro Toolkit is an easy to use Active Directory Tools that makes managing Active Directory fast, easy and efficient. Automate tasks that are consuming your time and resources.
Improvements
- Scheduled Reports: the Status column now shows how each task's last scheduled run went: Success, or Failed with the reason, instead of only reporting manual “Run Now” runs. A task that has been failing every night is now visible on the page rather than only in the service log. The column updates on its own while the page is open, and the full reason is shown on hover.
Bug Fixes
- Scheduled Reports: a failed run left the Last Run time showing the previous successful run, so there was no sign on the page that anything had gone wrong. Failed runs are now timestamped like successful ones.
- Browse OUs: searching for an OU and selecting a result now opens the tree at that OU with its contents showing, so a sub-OU can be picked from there. Previously the search only offered the OUs it matched, with no way to reach anything beneath them.
- Browse OUs: when choosing a single destination, such as moving a user to another OU, expanding the selected OU no longer ticks everything inside it.
- Modify Group: adding a member by picking a name from the suggestion list could add the computer account rather than the user when both had the same name. The object selected in the list is now the one added.
